checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: The body is a saturated medium/royal blue, brighter than a true navy. It is clearly blue but not dark navy.

must.item: Car retains shape, position, windows, tyres, trim, lights
must.why: Everything matches the original, including the red tail lights, plate, wheels and windows.

must.item: Shading and reflections consistent with sunny lighting
must.why: Highlights on the roof and the shadow gradients on the side panels are preserved.
The background looks identical. The distant red car stays red, which is correct.
Same framing and the same 640x384 size.

faults.what: The blue is brighter and more saturated than navy, so it only roughly matches the requested shade.

summary: The red hatchback is cleanly recoloured blue with the lighting and background intact, but the shade is a brighter royal blue rather than a true dark navy.
